item.title: Children’s Health Sees Development
item.description: Two local hospitals last month took steps to advance children’s health. Antelope Valley Medical Center, a 420-bed hospital in Lancaster, on Jan. 13 opened a pediatric intensive care unit. The expansion will allow the hospital to treat more complex cases, reducing the need to transfer pediatric patients to hospitals in the Los Angeles basin.
